mapper.select: SELECT * FROM backup_restore_log WHERE backup_id = #{backupId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgressCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rolledBackCount FROM backup_restore_log WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rolledBackCount, SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN restore_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgressCount, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs, MAX(create_time) AS latestRestoreTime FROM backup_restore_log WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM backup_restore_log WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
